text:
Maya (Design): Pushed a compact mock for the Alerts > SLO > Notification panel: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/alerts-slo. Big asks: make the notification preview lightweight, clarify suppression behavior, and tighten threshold copy. Needs quick design + a11y review. Ravi (PM): Thanks Maya. Key product constraints: default suppression for infra rollouts should be 10m; for user-facing errors keep default 0. Also we need to show which channels will actually receive the alert (user might select channels that are disabled). Lee (Frontend): On the preview: rather than live-rendering every integration, propose a selectable preview type (Slack / Email / PagerDuty) with cached templates. That way we only hydrate one renderer at a time. Jordan (SRE): From ops: incident grouping matters. If suppression is >0 we should surface whether subsequent events append to an existing incident or are ignored entirely. Suggested inline copy: "Within suppression window, events append to the same incident." aria-bot: Accessibility scan: contrast failure on yellow severity tag (#FFD27A) against white for 14px text. Recommend darkening to #E2A94B or using bold for text. Also flagged missing aria-live region for preview updates. Lina (Writer): Draft copy ideas: "Trigger threshold (percent)" for the numeric input; helper: "When error rate exceeds this percent over the selected window". For suppression toggle: label as "Suppression window (minutes)" and helper: "Prevent new incidents for N minutes after an alert fires". Maya (Design): Love the copy Lina. UX question: do we show presets (5m, 15m, 1h) or allow any number? Accessibility note: presets should be keyboard-focusable buttons. Lee (Frontend): Presets + free numeric input is best. Implement numeric input with step=1 and aria-label. We'll expose presets as segmented controls (button group). Avoid sliders — they're not precise. Ravi (PM): Also need a visual indicator if the channel selected for preview is unconfigured (e.g., grey badge + "not connected"). For sending test notifications, require explicit confirmation modal that explains it will send to live channels. Jordan (SRE): Agree on confirmation. Also request a rate-limit: only send 1 test per minute per workspace. We get noisy test sends otherwise. aria-bot: Also recommend using aria-describedby on the suppression input pointing to the helper text element, and aria-live="polite" for preview changes: ```
...
``` Lina (Writer): Copy for the test modal: Title: "Send test notification" Body: "This will send a sample alert to the selected channel. Only send if you have permission to post in that channel." Buttons: "Cancel" / "Send test". Maya (Design): Tiny visual tweak: move the channel selector to the preview header and add a chevron. That makes it clear the preview is channel-specific. Also add a light skeleton while template loads. Lee (Frontend): The chevron will be clickable — plan: dropdown with recent channels first and an option to open channel settings. Cache last selection in localStorage. Note: skeleton should be aria-hidden so it doesn't announce to screen readers. Ravi (PM): On thresholds: we need a quick-read summary string at top of the card like: "Alert when error rate > 5% for 5m". That helps non-technical folks scanning the page. Jordan (SRE): And include a simulated traffic example for preview: show a short timeline that indicates why the threshold would or would not have fired. Could be small sparkline with event markers. Maya (Design): Sparkline = nice but keep it subtle. It should be optional (toggle) so the panel remains compact by default. aria-bot: Contrast note: primary CTA hover state reduces contrast to fail AA. Make hover background slightly darker or increase border. Also ensure focus ring is at least 3px. Lina (Writer): Button copy variants: Use "Send test" not "Test notification". For the preview empty state: "No connected channels 2 connect a channel to preview how alerts will look". Lee (Frontend): Implementation plan bullets: 1) Channel selector dropdown + cache, 2) Client-side templates for Slack/Email/PD, 3) Numeric input + presets, 4) Confirmation modal for send, 5) aria-live region + aria-describedby. I'll PR the component and include tests for keyboard flow. Ravi (PM): Prioritize: copy + presets + confirmation modal + indicator for unconfigured channels. Sparkline and live sending optional for next sprint. Maya (Design): Action items: I'll update figma with presets, channel dropdown, and helper copy. Lina finalize strings, Lee to add aria attributes and keyboard behavior, Jordan to confirm default suppression policy for rollout alerts (10m). Lina (Writer): Will post final strings in this thread tonight. :pencil2: Lee (Frontend): I'll add the aria snippet to the component README and test in VoiceOver + NVDA. Jordan (SRE): I'll validate suppression defaults with Ops and follow up. Maya (Design): Thanks team. If you hit any blockers I'll unlist the component for the design review tomorrow. :white_check_mark: Ravi (PM): Thanks all. Closing thread once Figma and copy updates land. :rocket:
